ir.name: topk_pairs_gap_simpler_002
ir.intuition: Within each batch instance, build pairwise preferences by selecting the largest objective improvements (objective[j] - objective[i] above a threshold), treating i as the winner (lower objective) and j as the loser; this concentrates comparisons on clear separations while enforcing per-instance and global pair caps.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # [B, N]
    B, N = objective.shape

    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    per_inst_cap = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 8))

    # gap[b, i, j] = objective[b, j] - objective[b, i]
    # Positive gap means i is better than j when lower is better.
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]

    eye = torch.eye(N, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device)[None, :, :]
    valid = (gap > gap_thr) & (~eye)

    P = N * N
    gap_flat = gap.reshape(B, P)
    valid_flat = valid.reshape(B, P)

    neg_inf = torch.full((), float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    score = torch.where(valid_flat, gap_flat, neg_inf)

    k = per_inst_cap
    if k > P:
        k = P
    if k < 1:
        k = 1

    topv, topi = torch.topk(score, k=k, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
    keep = topv > neg_inf

    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None].expand(B, k)
    b_idx = b_grid[keep]
    flat_idx = topi[keep].to(torch.long)

    winner_idx = (flat_idx // N).to(torch.long)
    loser_idx = (flat_idx % N).to(torch.long)

    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        b_idx = b_idx[:max_pairs]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[:max_pairs]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[:max_pairs]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(
            b_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
            winner_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
            loser_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
        ),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'topk_pairs_gap_simpler',
            'gap_threshold': gap_thr,
            'max_pairs': max_pairs,
            'max_pairs_per_instance': per_inst_cap,
            'any_valid': bool(valid.any().item()),
        },
    )

ir.name: builder_anchor_gap_topk_000
ir.intuition: Build stable, bounded preferences by comparing a few best anchors against worse candidates, keeping only pairs with a minimum objective gap to avoid ambiguous supervision and controlling count via per-anchor top-k selection.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # objective: [B, N], lower is better
    B, N = objective.shape

    # Tunables (kept simple and robust)
    n_anchors = int(extra.get('n_anchors', 2))
    k_per_anchor = int(extra.get('k_per_anchor', 8))
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    n_anchors = max(1, min(n_anchors, N))
    k_per_anchor = max(1, min(k_per_anchor, N))
    max_pairs = max(1, max_pairs)

    # Anchors are the best candidates (lowest objective)
    anchor_idx = objective.topk(k=n_anchors, dim=1, largest=False).indices  # [B, A]
    anchor_obj = objective.gather(1, anchor_idx)  # [B, A]

    # For each anchor, select hard losers (largest objective) while excluding the anchor itself
    obj_exp = objective[:, None, :].expand(B, n_anchors, N)  # [B, A, N]
    is_anchor = torch.zeros((B, n_anchors, N), dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device)
    is_anchor.scatter_(2, anchor_idx.unsqueeze(-1), True)
    masked_obj = obj_exp.masked_fill(is_anchor, float('-inf'))

    loser_idx = masked_obj.topk(k=k_per_anchor, dim=2, largest=True).indices  # [B, A, K]
    loser_obj = objective.gather(1, loser_idx.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, n_anchors, k_per_anchor)  # [B, A, K]

    # Winner is the anchor
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, n_anchors, k_per_anchor)  # [B, A, K]
    winner_obj = anchor_obj[:, :, None].expand(B, n_anchors, k_per_anchor)  # [B, A, K]

    # Keep only sufficiently separated pairs
    gap = loser_obj - winner_obj
    keep = gap > gap_thr  # [B, A, K]

    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None, None].expand(B, n_anchors, k_per_anchor)
    b_idx = b_grid[keep]
    w_idx = winner_idx[keep]
    l_idx = loser_idx[keep]

    # Global cap without randomness: keep largest-gap pairs
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        gap_flat = gap[keep]
        sel = gap_flat.topk(k=max_pairs, largest=True).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[sel]
        w_idx = w_idx[sel]
        l_idx = l_idx[sel]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_gap_topk', 'n_anchors': n_anchors, 'k_per_anchor': k_per_anchor, 'gap_threshold': gap_thr, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

ir.name: builder_full_coverage_ties_002
ir.intuition: Ensure 100% within-instance coverage by creating at least one preference for every instance: use all strict (lower-objective) winner/loser pairs when they exist, and for tie-only instances add a single deterministic self-pair with zero weight (neutral) so the instance is still represented without introducing a directional preference.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # objective: [B, K] (lower is better)
    B, K = objective.shape

    # Strict preference pairs within each instance.
    win_mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_strict, w_strict, l_strict = win_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Nonnegative weights proportional to objective gap.
    gap = objective[b_strict, l_strict] - objective[b_strict, w_strict]
    w_weight = gap.clamp_min(0.0)

    # Identify instances with no strict pairs (all candidates tied).
    has_any = win_mask.any(dim=(1, 2))
    tie_b = (~has_any).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]

    # Add one neutral pair per tie-only instance: (i0, i0) with zero weight.
    if tie_b.numel() > 0:
        i0 = objective.new_zeros((tie_b.numel(),), dtype=torch.long)
        z = objective.new_zeros((tie_b.numel(),), dtype=objective.dtype)

        b_all = torch.cat([b_strict.to(torch.long), tie_b.to(torch.long)], dim=0)
        w_all = torch.cat([w_strict.to(torch.long), i0], dim=0)
        l_all = torch.cat([l_strict.to(torch.long), i0], dim=0)
        weight = torch.cat([w_weight, z], dim=0)
    else:
        b_all = b_strict.to(torch.long)
        w_all = w_strict.to(torch.long)
        l_all = l_strict.to(torch.long)
        weight = w_weight

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_all, w_all, l_all),
        weight=weight,
        meta={'builder': 'full_coverage_with_ties'}
    )

ir.name: builder_all_pairs_gap_weight_001
ir.intuition: Use all valid preference pairs but weight them by the (clipped) objective gap so clearer wins contribute more while near-ties are downweighted, improving signal-to-noise and generalization.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # lower objective is better
    mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Nonnegative weights based on objective gap (loser - winner), clipped to stabilize.
    gap = objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    w_max = extra.get('gap_weight_max', 10.0)
    weight = gap.clamp(min=0.0, max=w_max)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_gap_weight', 'gap_weight_max': float(w_max)})

ir.name: builder_stratified_rank_pairs
ir.intuition: Builds per-instance preferences by ranking candidates by objective (lower is better) and pairing across strata: near-best vs near-best (hard), near-best vs mid (informative), and near-best vs tail (easy), with a strict per-instance cap to ensure full coverage without enumerating all O(K^2) pairs.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Per-instance pairing budget (ensures full coverage by construction).
    budget = int(extra.get('pairs_per_instance', 2))
    budget = max(1, budget)

    # Rank candidates per instance by objective (ascending: best first).
    order = objective.argsort(dim=1)

    # Define strata sizes (all vectorized; robust for small K).
    top_n = int(extra.get('top_n', 4))
    mid_n = int(extra.get('mid_n', 4))
    tail_n = int(extra.get('tail_n', 4))
    top_n = max(1, min(top_n, K))
    tail_n = max(1, min(tail_n, K))

    # Ensure mid window fits between top and tail; allow overlap if K is small.
    max_mid = max(0, K - top_n - tail_n)
    mid_n = max(0, min(mid_n, max_mid))

    top = order[:, :top_n]
    if mid_n > 0:
        mid = order[:, top_n:top_n + mid_n]
    else:
        mid = order[:, :0]
    tail = order[:, K - tail_n:]

    # Allocate how many pairs from each stratum pairing.
    hard_n = budget // 2
    info_n = budget - hard_n

    # Hard pairs: adjacent within top (top[i] beats top[i+1]).
    hard_n = min(hard_n, max(0, top_n - 1))
    if hard_n > 0:
        w_h = top[:, :hard_n]
        l_h = top[:, 1:hard_n + 1]
    else:
        w_h = top[:, :0]
        l_h = top[:, :0]

    # Informative pairs: best beats mid or tail (prefer mid if available).
    best = top[:, :1]
    if mid_n > 0:
        take = min(info_n, mid_n)
        w_m = best.expand(B, take)
        l_m = mid[:, :take]
        rem = info_n - take
        take_tail = min(rem, tail_n)
        w_t = best.expand(B, take_tail)
        l_t = tail[:, :take_tail]
    else:
        take_tail = min(info_n, tail_n)
        w_t = best.expand(B, take_tail)
        l_t = tail[:, :take_tail]
        w_m = best[:, :0]
        l_m = best[:, :0]

    # Concatenate per-instance pairs and flatten.
    winners = torch.cat([w_h, w_m, w_t], dim=1)
    losers = torch.cat([l_h, l_m, l_t], dim=1)

    # Guarantee at least one pair per instance (fallback: best vs worst).
    if winners.shape[1] == 0:
        winners = order[:, :1]
        losers = order[:, -1:]

    P = winners.shape[1]
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device)[:, None].expand(B, P).reshape(-1)
    winner_idx = winners.reshape(-1)
    loser_idx = losers.reshape(-1)

    # Ensure strict preference direction (lower objective is better): winner must have <= loser.
    ow = objective.gather(1, winner_idx.view(B, P)).reshape(-1)
    ol = objective.gather(1, loser_idx.view(B, P)).reshape(-1)
    keep = ow <= ol
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[keep]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[keep]

    # If filtering removed everything (e.g., NaNs), fallback to best vs worst without filtering.
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        winners = order[:, :1]
        losers = order[:, -1:]
        b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device)
        winner_idx = winners.reshape(-1)
        loser_idx = losers.reshape(-1)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'stratified_rank_pairs', 'pairs_per_instance': budget, 'top_n': top_n, 'mid_n': mid_n, 'tail_n': tail_n})

ir.name: builder_topk_gap_anchors
ir.intuition: Create stable, informative preferences by pairing the best (lowest objective) candidates against the worst (highest objective) candidates per instance, then keep only the largest objective gaps globally to fit the pairing budget without randomness.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # objective: [B, N], lower is better
    B, N = objective.shape

    # Anchor construction: compare top-k best vs top-k worst within each instance.
    k = int(extra.get('k', 4))
    k = max(1, min(k, N))

    # Indices of best and worst candidates per batch element.
    best_val, best_idx = torch.topk(objective, k=k, dim=1, largest=False)
    worst_val, worst_idx = torch.topk(objective, k=k, dim=1, largest=True)

    # Build all k^2 pairs per instance: (winner=best, loser=worst).
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None, None].expand(B, k, k)
    winner_idx = best_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, k, k)
    loser_idx = worst_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, k, k)

    # Compute objective gap (loser - winner); keep only sufficiently separated pairs.
    gap = (objective.gather(1, loser_idx.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, k, k) -
           objective.gather(1, winner_idx.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, k, k))

    gap_threshold = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    valid = gap > gap_threshold

    # Flatten and filter.
    b_flat = b_idx.reshape(-1)
    w_flat = winner_idx.reshape(-1)
    l_flat = loser_idx.reshape(-1)
    gap_flat = gap.reshape(-1)
    valid_flat = valid.reshape(-1)

    b_flat = b_flat[valid_flat]
    w_flat = w_flat[valid_flat]
    l_flat = l_flat[valid_flat]
    gap_flat = gap_flat[valid_flat]

    # Budget control: deterministically keep the largest-gap pairs.
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    max_pairs = max(1, max_pairs)
    if gap_flat.numel() > max_pairs:
        _, sel = torch.topk(gap_flat, k=max_pairs, largest=True)
        b_flat = b_flat[sel]
        w_flat = w_flat[sel]
        l_flat = l_flat[sel]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_flat, w_flat, l_flat), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'topk_gap_anchors', 'k': k, 'gap_threshold': gap_threshold, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

ir.name: builder_stratified_rank_cap_005
ir.intuition: All parents reliably derive pairwise preferences from objective ordering, but they either explode to all pairs or rely on random subsampling and don’t guarantee per-instance coverage; this builder keeps deterministic objective-based correctness while switching to rank-stratified, per-instance capped pairing (near-best, mid, tail) to cover each instance with a fixed budget.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # objective: [B, K], lower is better
    B, K = objective.shape

    # Per-instance cap; ensures full coverage by generating >= 1 pair per instance when K>=2.
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 2))
    if max_pairs_per_instance < 1:
        max_pairs_per_instance = 1

    # If not enough candidates to form pairs, return empty (gate should avoid this case in normal use).
    if K < 2:
        empty = objective.new_zeros((0,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'stratified_rank_cap', 'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs_per_instance})

    # Rank candidates within each instance.
    # sorted_idx: [B, K], best (lowest objective) first
    sorted_idx = objective.argsort(dim=1)

    # Choose stratified anchors in rank-space.
    # Always include best; include mid and tail if budget allows.
    anchors_count = 1
    if max_pairs_per_instance >= 2:
        anchors_count = 2
    if max_pairs_per_instance >= 3:
        anchors_count = 3

    best = sorted_idx[:, 0]
    mid = sorted_idx[:, K // 2]
    tail = sorted_idx[:, -1]
    anchors = torch.stack([best, mid, tail], dim=1)[:, :anchors_count]  # [B, A]

    # For each anchor, pick a loser at a fixed rank offset (hard negatives by rank proximity).
    # Offsets are deterministic and avoid Python loops.
    if anchors_count == 1:
        offsets = objective.new_tensor([max(1, K // 4)], dtype=torch.long)[None, :]  # [1,1]
    elif anchors_count == 2:
        offsets = objective.new_tensor([max(1, K // 4), max(1, K // 2)], dtype=torch.long)[None, :]  # [1,2]
    else:
        offsets = objective.new_tensor([max(1, K // 6), max(1, K // 3), max(1, K // 2)], dtype=torch.long)[None, :]  # [1,3]

    # Map anchor indices -> their rank positions to add offsets.
    # ranks[b, idx] = rank position in sorted order.
    ranks = torch.empty((B, K), device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
    ranks.scatter_(1, sorted_idx, torch.arange(K, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long).expand(B, K))

    anchor_ranks = ranks.gather(1, anchors)  # [B, A]
    loser_ranks = (anchor_ranks + offsets).clamp_(0, K - 1)  # [B, A]
    losers = sorted_idx.gather(1, loser_ranks)  # [B, A]

    # Determine winner/loser direction from objective to handle ties/edge cases.
    obj_a = objective.gather(1, anchors)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, losers)
    # winner_mask True means anchor is better (lower objective); else loser is better or tie.
    winner_mask = obj_a <= obj_l
    winners = torch.where(winner_mask, anchors, losers)
    losers = torch.where(winner_mask, losers, anchors)

    # Flatten to pair index vectors.
    A = winners.shape[1]
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None].expand(B, A).reshape(-1)
    winner_idx = winners.reshape(-1)
    loser_idx = losers.reshape(-1)

    # Remove self-pairs (can occur if offsets clamp to same rank when K small).
    valid = winner_idx != loser_idx
    b_idx = b_idx[valid]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[valid]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[valid]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={'builder': 'stratified_rank_cap', 'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs_per_instance, 'anchors': anchors_count}
    )

ir.name: builder_all_pairs_gap_weight_001
ir.intuition: Downweight near-ties by using a nonnegative preference weight proportional to the objective gap, so clearer improvements contribute more signal while still keeping full pair coverage.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # objective: lower is better
    mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    gap = objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    # Nonnegative weight; emphasize clearer wins while keeping all valid pairs.
    scale = extra.get('gap_scale', 1.0)
    weight = (gap / (gap + scale)).clamp_min(0.0)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_gap_weight', 'gap_scale': float(scale)})

ir.name: anchor_gap_topk_v1
ir.intuition: Create robust pairwise preferences by anchoring comparisons around the best and worst candidates per instance, only keeping pairs with sufficient objective gap, and capping total pairs via vectorized top-k selection on gap magnitude (no randomness).
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Pair (winner, loser) when objective is lower (lower_is_better).
    best_idx = objective.argmin(dim=1)  # [B]
    worst_idx = objective.argmax(dim=1)  # [B]

    arN = torch.arange(N, device=device)
    arB = torch.arange(B, device=device)

    # Best anchor: best beats all others.
    best_vs_all_mask = arN[None, :] != best_idx[:, None]
    b1 = arB[:, None].expand(B, N)[best_vs_all_mask]
    w1 = best_idx[:, None].expand(B, N)[best_vs_all_mask]
    l1 = arN[None, :].expand(B, N)[best_vs_all_mask]

    # Worst anchor: everyone beats worst.
    worst_vs_all_mask = arN[None, :] != worst_idx[:, None]
    b2 = arB[:, None].expand(B, N)[worst_vs_all_mask]
    w2 = arN[None, :].expand(B, N)[worst_vs_all_mask]
    l2 = worst_idx[:, None].expand(B, N)[worst_vs_all_mask]

    b_idx = torch.cat([b1, b2], dim=0)
    winner_idx = torch.cat([w1, w2], dim=0)
    loser_idx = torch.cat([l1, l2], dim=0)

    # Filter by objective gap to avoid noisy/near-ties.
    gap = objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    keep = gap > thr
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[keep]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[keep]
    gap = gap[keep]

    # Cap total pairs deterministically by keeping the largest gaps.
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_idx = torch.topk(gap, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_gap_topk', 'max_pairs': max_pairs, 'gap_threshold': thr})

ir.name: builder_topk_pairs_gap_003
ir.intuition: Constructs pairwise preferences by ranking candidates by objective (lower is better) and selecting the strongest winner-loser gaps per instance, optionally ignoring near-ties to reduce noisy comparisons while staying within a configurable pair budget.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # objective: [B, N], lower is better
    B, N = objective.shape

    # Configurable knobs
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 16))

    # Pairwise gaps (positive means i better than j by that margin)
    gap = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]  # [B, N, N]

    # Valid winner/loser pairs: i is winner if objective_i < objective_j, and gap magnitude exceeds threshold
    valid = (gap < -gap_thr)

    # Score by strength of preference (larger is better): objective_j - objective_i
    score = (-gap).clamp_min(0.0)

    # Mask invalid by -inf so topk ignores them
    neg_inf = score.new_full((), float('-inf'))
    masked_score = torch.where(valid, score, neg_inf)  # [B, N, N]

    # Select top-k per instance (flattened over (winner, loser))
    k_inst = max(1, min(max_pairs_per_instance, N * N))
    flat = masked_score.view(B, N * N)
    topv, topi = flat.topk(k_inst, dim=1)

    # Keep only finite scores (i.e., valid pairs)
    keep = torch.isfinite(topv)  # [B, k_inst]

    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, k_inst)
    wi = (topi // N)
    li = (topi % N)

    # Apply keep mask and globally cap without randomness
    b_idx = b_idx[keep]
    wi = wi[keep]
    li = li[keep]

    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        b_idx = b_idx[:max_pairs]
        wi = wi[:max_pairs]
        li = li[:max_pairs]

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # [B, N] lower is better
    B, N = objective.shape

    # Per-instance pairing budget and global budget
    per_inst_cap = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 8))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    per_inst_cap = max(1, per_inst_cap)
    max_pairs = max(1, max_pairs)

    # Stratification controls (all in ranks)
    n_winners = int(extra.get('n_winners', 2))
    n_mid = int(extra.get('n_mid', 2))
    n_tail = int(extra.get('n_tail', 2))
    n_winners = max(1, min(n_winners, N))
    n_mid = max(1, min(n_mid, N))
    n_tail = max(1, min(n_tail, N))

    # Compute rank positions via sorted indices
    # best_idx: [B, N] where best_idx[b, 0] is argmin objective
    best_idx = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1, descending=False)

    # Winner pool: near-best
    win_idx = best_idx[:, :n_winners]  # [B, W]

    # Tail pool: worst
    tail_idx = best_idx[:, N - n_tail:]  # [B, T]

    # Mid pool: centered around median ranks (avoid overlapping winners/tail when possible)
    mid_center = N // 2
    mid_start = max(0, min(N - n_mid, mid_center - (n_mid // 2)))
    mid_idx = best_idx[:, mid_start:mid_start + n_mid]  # [B, M]

    # Build stratified pairs per instance:
    # - winners vs mid
    # - winners vs tail
    b_grid_wm = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None, None].expand(B, n_winners, n_mid)
    w_wm = win_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, n_winners, n_mid)
    l_wm = mid_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, n_winners, n_mid)

    b_grid_wt = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None, None].expand(B, n_winners, n_tail)
    w_wt = win_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, n_winners, n_tail)
    l_wt = tail_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, n_winners, n_tail)

    # Concatenate candidate pairs
    b_all = torch.cat([b_grid_wm.reshape(B, -1), b_grid_wt.reshape(B, -1)], dim=1)  # [B, P]
    w_all = torch.cat([w_wm.reshape(B, -1), w_wt.reshape(B, -1)], dim=1)  # [B, P]
    l_all = torch.cat([l_wm.reshape(B, -1), l_wt.reshape(B, -1)], dim=1)  # [B, P]

    # Validity: exclude self-pairs and enforce objective winner < loser.
    # Rank-based construction should already satisfy, but duplicates/overlaps can happen for small N.
    gap = objective.gather(1, l_all) - objective.gather(1, w_all)  # [B, P]
    valid = (w_all != l_all) & (gap > 0)

    # Score: prefer clearer separations but selection is still rank-stratified.
    neg_inf = torch.full((), float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    score = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)  # [B, P]

    P = score.shape[1]
    k = min(per_inst_cap, P)
    if k < 1:
        k = 1

    topv, topi = torch.topk(score, k=k, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)  # [B, k]
    keep = topv > neg_inf

    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None].expand(B, k)
    b_idx = b_grid[keep]
    sel = topi[keep].to(torch.long)
    w_idx = w_all.gather(1, topi).reshape(B, k)[keep].to(torch.long)
    l_idx = l_all.gather(1, topi).reshape(B, k)[keep].to(torch.long)

    # Ensure full coverage: if some instances produced no valid pairs, add a deterministic fallback pair
    # using best vs worst for those instances.
    per_b_count = torch.zeros((B,), device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
    per_b_count.scatter_add_(0, b_idx, torch.ones_like(b_idx, dtype=torch.long))
    missing = per_b_count == 0
    if bool(missing.any().item()):
        b_m = torch.nonzero(missing, as_tuple=True)[0]
        w_m = best_idx[b_m, 0]
        l_m = best_idx[b_m, -1]
        # Keep only if not self and actually improves
        gap_m = objective[b_m, l_m] - objective[b_m, w_m]
        ok_m = (w_m != l_m) & (gap_m > 0)
        b_m = b_m[ok_m]
        w_m = w_m[ok_m]
        l_m = l_m[ok_m]
        b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_m.to(torch.long)], dim=0)
        w_idx = torch.cat([w_idx, w_m.to(torch.long)], dim=0)
        l_idx = torch.cat([l_idx, l_m.to(torch.long)], dim=0)

    # Global cap while preserving at least one pair per instance when possible.
    # First keep one best-scoring pair per instance, then fill remaining by score.
    total = b_idx.numel()
    if total > max_pairs:
        # Compute scores for current pairs
        gap_sel = objective[b_idx, l_idx] - objective[b_idx, w_idx]

        # Best per instance
        best_score = torch.full((B,), float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        best_pos = torch.full((B,), -1, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
        # Reduce-max via scatter: compute max score per b
        best_score = best_score.scatter_reduce(0, b_idx, gap_sel, reduce='amax', include_self=True)
        # Mark positions matching the max score for each instance, then pick first occurrence deterministically
        is_best = gap_sel == best_score[b_idx]
        pos = torch.arange(total, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
        pos_best = torch.where(is_best, pos, torch.full_like(pos, total))
        best_pos = best_pos.scatter_reduce(0, b_idx, pos_best, reduce='amin', include_self=True)
        has_best = best_pos >= 0
        core_pos = best_pos[has_best]

        core_mask = torch.zeros((total,), device=objective.device, dtype=torch.bool)
        core_mask[core_pos] = True

        # Remaining slots
        remaining = max_pairs - int(core_mask.sum().item())
        if remaining < 0:
            remaining = 0

        if remaining == 0:
            sel_pos = core_pos
        else:
            rest_score = gap_sel.masked_fill(core_mask, float('-inf'))
            rest_k = min(remaining, total)
            _, rest_pos = torch.topk(rest_score, k=rest_k, largest=True, sorted=False)
            # Filter out -inf selections
            rest_keep = rest_score[rest_pos] > float('-inf')
            rest_pos = rest_pos[rest_keep]
            sel_pos = torch.cat([core_pos, rest_pos], dim=0)
            if sel_pos.numel() > max_pairs:
                sel_pos = sel_pos[:max_pairs]

        b_idx = b_idx[sel_pos]
        w_idx = w_idx[sel_pos]
        l_idx = l_idx[sel_pos]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1), w_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1), l_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1)),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_stratified_covercap',
            'n_winners': n_winners,
            'n_mid': n_mid,
            'n_tail': n_tail,
            'max_pairs': max_pairs,
            'max_pairs_per_instance': per_inst_cap,
        },
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # [B, N], lower is better
    B, N = objective.shape

    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    if max_pairs < 1:
        max_pairs = 1
    per_inst_cap = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 8))
    if per_inst_cap < 1:
        per_inst_cap = 1

    q = float(extra.get('quantile', 0.25))
    if q < 0.1:
        q = 0.1
    if q > 0.45:
        q = 0.45

    # Avoid Python round(); use floor-like int() deterministically.
    k = int(q * float(N))
    if k < 1:
        k = 1
    if k > N:
        k = N

    sorted_obj, sorted_idx = torch.sort(objective, dim=1, descending=False)

    head_k = k
    tail_k = k

    mid_start = head_k
    mid_end = N - tail_k
    if mid_end <= mid_start:
        mid_end = min(N, mid_start + 1)
    mid_len = mid_end - mid_start
    if mid_len < 1:
        mid_len = 1
    if mid_start + mid_len > N:
        mid_len = max(1, N - mid_start)

    head_idx = sorted_idx[:, :head_k]  # [B, H]
    tail_idx = sorted_idx[:, N - tail_k:]  # [B, T]
    mid_idx = sorted_idx[:, mid_start:mid_start + mid_len]  # [B, M]

    H = head_idx.shape[1]
    M = mid_idx.shape[1]
    T = tail_idx.shape[1]

    # Build stratified pair candidates.
    b0 = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)

    b_hm = b0[:, None, None].expand(B, H, M)
    w_hm = head_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, H, M)
    l_hm = mid_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, H, M)

    b_mt = b0[:, None, None].expand(B, M, T)
    w_mt = mid_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, M, T)
    l_mt = tail_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, M, T)

    b_ht = b0[:, None, None].expand(B, H, T)
    w_ht = head_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, H, T)
    l_ht = tail_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, H, T)

    b_all = torch.cat([b_hm.reshape(-1), b_mt.reshape(-1), b_ht.reshape(-1)], dim=0)
    w_all = torch.cat([w_hm.reshape(-1), w_mt.reshape(-1), w_ht.reshape(-1)], dim=0)
    l_all = torch.cat([l_hm.reshape(-1), l_mt.reshape(-1), l_ht.reshape(-1)], dim=0)

    gap = objective[b_all, l_all] - objective[b_all, w_all]
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    valid = gap > gap_thr

    b_all = b_all[valid]
    w_all = w_all[valid]
    l_all = l_all[valid]
    gap = gap[valid]

    # Enforce coverage: if any instance has zero pairs, add best-vs-worst.
    if B > 0:
        counts = torch.zeros((B,), device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
        if b_all.numel() > 0:
            ones = torch.ones_like(b_all, dtype=torch.long)
            counts = counts.scatter_add(0, b_all.to(torch.long), ones)
        missing = counts == 0
        if bool(missing.any().item()):
            b_miss = missing.nonzero(as_tuple=False).reshape(-1).to(torch.long)
            w_miss = sorted_idx[b_miss, 0]
            l_miss = sorted_idx[b_miss, N - 1]
            gap_miss = objective[b_miss, l_miss] - objective[b_miss, w_miss]
            b_all = torch.cat([b_all, b_miss], dim=0)
            w_all = torch.cat([w_all, w_miss], dim=0)
            l_all = torch.cat([l_all, l_miss], dim=0)
            gap = torch.cat([gap, gap_miss], dim=0)

    total_candidates = b_all.numel()
    if total_candidates == 0:
        # Final fallback: all instances best vs worst.
        b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
        w_idx = sorted_idx[:, 0]
        l_idx = sorted_idx[:, N - 1]
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(b_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1), w_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1), l_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1)),
            weight=None,
            meta={
                'builder': 'rank_strata_no_round_001_fix',
                'quantile': q,
                'gap_threshold': gap_thr,
                'max_pairs': max_pairs,
                'max_pairs_per_instance': per_inst_cap,
                'note': 'fallback_all_best_vs_worst'
            }
        )

    # Per-instance cap using a padded score matrix (no Python loops over pairs).
    neg_inf = torch.full((), float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    score_mat = torch.full((B, total_candidates), neg_inf, device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    col = torch.arange(total_candidates, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
    score_mat[b_all.to(torch.long), col] = gap

    K = per_inst_cap
    if K > total_candidates:
        K = total_candidates
    if K < 1:
        K = 1

    topv, topi = torch.topk(score_mat, k=K, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
    keep = topv > neg_inf

    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None].expand(B, K)
    b_idx = b_grid[keep]
    col_sel = topi[keep].to(torch.long)

    w_idx = w_all[col_sel]
    l_idx = l_all[col_sel]
    gap_sel = gap[col_sel]

    # Global budget: keep largest gaps deterministically.
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        _, sel = torch.topk(gap_sel, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[sel]
        w_idx = w_idx[sel]
        l_idx = l_idx[sel]
        gap_sel = gap_sel[sel]

    gap_scale = float(extra.get('gap_scale', 1.0))
    if gap_scale <= 0.0:
        gap_scale = 1e-8
    weight = (gap_sel / (gap_sel + gap_scale)).clamp_min(0.0)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1), w_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1), l_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1)),
        weight=weight.reshape(-1),

            'builder': 'rank_strata_no_round_001_fix',
            'quantile': q,
            'gap_threshold': gap_thr,
            'gap_scale': gap_scale,
            'max_pairs': max_pairs,
            'max_pairs_per_instance': per_inst_cap,
            'strata_sizes': {'head': int(H), 'mid': int(M), 'tail': int(T)},
            'any_pairs': bool((b_idx.numel() > 0))

    )

    B, N = objective.shape

    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    max_pairs = max(1, max_pairs)

    n_anchors = int(extra.get('n_anchors', 2))
    k_losers = int(extra.get('k_losers', 8))
    n_anchors = max(1, min(n_anchors, N))
    k_losers = max(1, min(k_losers, N))

    w_max = float(extra.get('gap_weight_max', 10.0))

    # Best anchors (winners)
    anchor_idx = torch.topk(objective, k=n_anchors, dim=1, largest=False).indices  # [B, A]
    anchor_obj = objective.gather(1, anchor_idx)  # [B, A]

    # Candidate losers: worst objectives per instance (expanded over anchors)
    obj_exp = objective[:, None, :].expand(B, n_anchors, N)  # [B, A, N]

    # Exclude each anchor itself from its loser set
    is_self = torch.zeros((B, n_anchors, N), dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device)
    is_self.scatter_(2, anchor_idx.unsqueeze(-1), True)
    masked_obj = obj_exp.masked_fill(is_self, float('-inf'))

    loser_idx = torch.topk(masked_obj, k=k_losers, dim=2, largest=True).indices  # [B, A, K]
    loser_obj = objective.gather(1, loser_idx.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, n_anchors, k_losers)  # [B, A, K]

    winner_idx = anchor_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, n_anchors, k_losers)  # [B, A, K]
    winner_obj = anchor_obj[:, :, None].expand(B, n_anchors, k_losers)  # [B, A, K]

    gap = loser_obj - winner_obj  # [B, A, K]
    keep = gap > gap_thr

    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None, None].expand(B, n_anchors, k_losers)
    b_idx = b_grid[keep]
    w_idx = winner_idx[keep]
    l_idx = loser_idx[keep]
    gap_kept = gap[keep]

    # Always ensure at least one pair per instance (coverage): fall back to best-vs-worst when no kept pairs.
    any_per_b = keep.reshape(B, -1).any(dim=1)  # [B]
    need = ~any_per_b
    if bool(need.any().item()):
        best_idx = torch.topk(objective, k=1, dim=1, largest=False).indices.squeeze(1)  # [B]
        worst_idx = torch.topk(objective, k=1, dim=1, largest=True).indices.squeeze(1)  # [B]
        best_obj = objective.gather(1, best_idx[:, None]).squeeze(1)
        worst_obj = objective.gather(1, worst_idx[:, None]).squeeze(1)
        gap_fallback = worst_obj - best_obj

        l_fb = worst_idx[need]
        g_fb = gap_fallback[need]

        w_idx = torch.cat([w_idx, w_fb], dim=0)
        l_idx = torch.cat([l_idx, l_fb], dim=0)

        b_idx = b_idx[sel]
        w_idx = w_idx[sel]
        l_idx = l_idx[sel]
        weight = weight[sel]

        pair_idx=(
            b_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
            w_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
            l_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),

            'k_losers': int(k_losers),

            'coverage_fallback': True,

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']

    per_inst_cap = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 8192))
    weight_scale = float(extra.get('weight_scale', 1.0))
    max_weight = float(extra.get('max_weight', 10.0))

    # gap[b, i, j] = objective[b, j] - objective[b, i] (positive means i beats j)
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]

    eye = torch.eye(K, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device)[None, :, :]
    valid = (gap > gap_thr) & (~eye)

    P = K * K
    gap_flat = gap.reshape(B, P)
    valid_flat = valid.reshape(B, P)

    neg_inf = torch.full((), float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    score = torch.where(valid_flat, gap_flat, neg_inf)

    k = per_inst_cap
    if k > P:
        k = P
    if k < 1:
        k = 1

    topv, topi = torch.topk(score, k=k, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
    keep = topv > neg_inf

    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None].expand(B, k)

    w_weight = (topv[keep].clamp_min(0.0) * weight_scale).clamp_max(max_weight)

    # Instances with no valid strict pairs after thresholding/capping.

    tie_b = (~has_any).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]

    # Add one neutral pair per empty instance: (0,0) with zero weight.
    if tie_b.numel() > 0:
        i0 = objective.new_zeros((tie_b.numel(),), dtype=torch.long)
        z = objective.new_zeros((tie_b.numel(),), dtype=objective.dtype)

        w_all = torch.cat([w_strict.to(torch.long), i0], dim=0)
        l_all = torch.cat([l_strict.to(torch.long), i0], dim=0)
        weight = torch.cat([w_weight, z], dim=0)
    else:
        b_all = b_strict.to(torch.long)
        w_all = w_strict.to(torch.long)
        l_all = l_strict.to(torch.long)
        weight = w_weight

    # Global cap (deterministic slice).
    if b_all.numel() > max_pairs:
        b_all = b_all[:max_pairs]

        l_all = l_all[:max_pairs]

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # [B, N], lower is better
    B, N = objective.shape

    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    if max_pairs < 1:
        max_pairs = 1
    per_inst_cap = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 8))
    if per_inst_cap < 1:
        per_inst_cap = 1

    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))

    # Stratified candidate sizes (rank-based, deterministic).
    n_winners = int(extra.get('n_winners', 2))
    n_mid = int(extra.get('n_mid', 2))
    n_tail = int(extra.get('n_tail', 2))
    n_winners = max(1, min(n_winners, N))
    n_mid = max(1, min(n_mid, N))
    n_tail = max(1, min(n_tail, N))

    sorted_obj, sorted_idx = torch.sort(objective, dim=1, descending=False)

    win_idx = sorted_idx[:, :n_winners]               # [B, W]
    tail_idx = sorted_idx[:, N - n_tail:]             # [B, T]

    mid_center = N // 2
    mid_start = max(0, min(N - n_mid, mid_center - (n_mid // 2)))
    mid_idx = sorted_idx[:, mid_start:mid_start + n_mid]  # [B, M]

    b0 = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)

    # Candidate pairs: winners vs mid, winners vs tail.
    b_wm = b0[:, None, None].expand(B, n_winners, n_mid)
    w_wm = win_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, n_winners, n_mid)
    l_wm = mid_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, n_winners, n_mid)

    b_wt = b0[:, None, None].expand(B, n_winners, n_tail)
    w_wt = win_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, n_winners, n_tail)
    l_wt = tail_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, n_winners, n_tail)

    b_cand = torch.cat([b_wm.reshape(-1), b_wt.reshape(-1)], dim=0)
    w_cand = torch.cat([w_wm.reshape(-1), w_wt.reshape(-1)], dim=0)
    l_cand = torch.cat([l_wm.reshape(-1), l_wt.reshape(-1)], dim=0)

    # Strict preferences only (plus deterministic per-instance fallback added later).
    gap_cand = objective[b_cand, l_cand] - objective[b_cand, w_cand]
    valid = (w_cand != l_cand) & (gap_cand > gap_thr)

    b_cand = b_cand[valid]
    w_cand = w_cand[valid]
    l_cand = l_cand[valid]
    gap_cand = gap_cand[valid]

    # Always include best-vs-worst strict pair when it improves (coverage anchor).
    w_f = sorted_idx[:, 0]
    l_f = sorted_idx[:, N - 1]
    gap_f = objective[b0, l_f] - objective[b0, w_f]
    ok_f = (w_f != l_f) & (gap_f > gap_thr)

    b_all = torch.cat([b_cand, b0[ok_f]], dim=0)
    w_all = torch.cat([w_cand, w_f[ok_f]], dim=0)
    l_all = torch.cat([l_cand, l_f[ok_f]], dim=0)
    gap_all = torch.cat([gap_cand, gap_f[ok_f]], dim=0)

    total = b_all.numel()

    # If absolutely no strict pairs exist (all ties / threshold too high), add one neutral self-pair per instance.
    if total == 0:
        z = objective.new_zeros((B,), dtype=objective.dtype)
        i0 = objective.new_zeros((B,), dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(b0.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1), i0.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1), i0.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1)),
            weight=z.reshape(-1),
            meta={
                'builder': 'cover_strata_topk_gapw_001',
                'note': 'all_ties_or_thresholded_out'
            },
        )

    # Per-instance cap: create a score matrix with -inf padding and take topk per row.
    neg_inf = torch.full((), float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    score_mat = torch.full((B, total), neg_inf, device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    col = torch.arange(total, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
    score_mat[b_all, col] = gap_all

    k = per_inst_cap
    if k > total:
        k = total
    if k < 1:
        k = 1

    topv, topi = torch.topk(score_mat, k=k, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
    keep = topv > neg_inf

    b_grid = b0[:, None].expand(B, k)
    b_idx = b_grid[keep]
    col_sel = topi[keep].to(torch.long)

    w_idx = w_all[col_sel]
    l_idx = l_all[col_sel]
    gap_sel = gap_all[col_sel]

    # Global cap: keep the largest gaps deterministically.
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        _, sel = torch.topk(gap_sel, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[sel]
        w_idx = w_idx[sel]
        l_idx = l_idx[sel]
        gap_sel = gap_sel[sel]

    # Nonnegative stable weights from gap: w = (gap/(gap+scale))^power, optional clip.
    gap_scale = float(extra.get('gap_scale', 1.0))
    if gap_scale <= 0.0:
        gap_scale = 1e-8
    weight_power = float(extra.get('weight_power', 1.0))
    weight_clip = float(extra.get('weight_clip', 0.0))  # 0 disables

    wgt = (gap_sel / (gap_sel + gap_scale)).clamp_min(0.0)
    if weight_power != 1.0:
        wgt = wgt.pow(weight_power)
    if weight_clip > 0.0:
        wgt = wgt.clamp_max(weight_clip)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1), w_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1), l_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1)),
        weight=wgt.reshape(-1),
        meta={
            'builder': 'cover_strata_topk_gapw_001',
            'gap_threshold': gap_thr,
            'gap_scale': gap_scale,
            'weight_power': weight_power,
            'weight_clip': weight_clip,
            'n_winners': n_winners,
            'n_mid': n_mid,
            'n_tail': n_tail,
            'max_pairs': max_pairs,
            'max_pairs_per_instance': per_inst_cap,
        },
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # [B, N] lower is better
    B, N = objective.shape

    # Budgets
    per_inst_cap = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 8))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    per_inst_cap = max(1, per_inst_cap)
    max_pairs = max(1, max_pairs)

    # Stratification controls (ranks)
    n_winners = int(extra.get('n_winners', 2))
    n_mid = int(extra.get('n_mid', 2))
    n_tail = int(extra.get('n_tail', 2))
    n_winners = max(1, min(n_winners, N))
    n_mid = max(1, min(n_mid, N))
    n_tail = max(1, min(n_tail, N))

    # Gap thresholding: avoid constructing preferences from near-ties.
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 1e-6))

    best_idx = torch.argsort(objective, dim=1, descending=False)  # [B, N]

    win_idx = best_idx[:, :n_winners]  # [B, W]
    tail_idx = best_idx[:, N - n_tail:]  # [B, T]

    mid_center = N // 2
    mid_start = max(0, min(N - n_mid, mid_center - (n_mid // 2)))
    mid_idx = best_idx[:, mid_start:mid_start + n_mid]  # [B, M]

    # Build pairs per instance: winners vs mid and winners vs tail
    b_wm = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None, None].expand(B, n_winners, n_mid)
    w_wm = win_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, n_winners, n_mid)
    l_wm = mid_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, n_winners, n_mid)

    b_wt = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None, None].expand(B, n_winners, n_tail)
    w_wt = win_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, n_winners, n_tail)
    l_wt = tail_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, n_winners, n_tail)

    b_all = torch.cat([b_wm.reshape(B, -1), b_wt.reshape(B, -1)], dim=1)  # [B, P]
    w_all = torch.cat([w_wm.reshape(B, -1), w_wt.reshape(B, -1)], dim=1)  # [B, P]
    l_all = torch.cat([l_wm.reshape(B, -1), l_wt.reshape(B, -1)], dim=1)  # [B, P]

    # Validity and score
    gap = objective.gather(1, l_all) - objective.gather(1, w_all)  # [B, P]
    valid = (w_all != l_all) & (gap > gap_thr)

    neg_inf = torch.full((), float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    score = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)

    P = score.shape[1]
    k = min(per_inst_cap, P)
    if k < 1:
        k = 1

    topv, topi = torch.topk(score, k=k, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)  # [B, k]
    keep = topv > neg_inf

    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None].expand(B, k)
    b_idx = b_grid[keep]
    w_idx = w_all.gather(1, topi).reshape(B, k)[keep].to(torch.long)
    l_idx = l_all.gather(1, topi).reshape(B, k)[keep].to(torch.long)

    # Coverage fallback: best vs worst (ignore gap_thr so we still cover instances with tiny spreads)
    per_b_count = torch.zeros((B,), device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
    if b_idx.numel() > 0:
        per_b_count.scatter_add_(0, b_idx, torch.ones_like(b_idx, dtype=torch.long))
    missing = per_b_count == 0
    if bool(missing.any().item()):
        b_m = torch.nonzero(missing, as_tuple=True)[0]
        w_m = best_idx[b_m, 0]
        l_m = best_idx[b_m, -1]
        gap_m = objective[b_m, l_m] - objective[b_m, w_m]
        ok_m = (w_m != l_m) & (gap_m > 0)
        b_m = b_m[ok_m]
        w_m = w_m[ok_m]
        l_m = l_m[ok_m]
        if b_m.numel() > 0:
            b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_m.to(torch.long)], dim=0)
            w_idx = torch.cat([w_idx, w_m.to(torch.long)], dim=0)
            l_idx = torch.cat([l_idx, l_m.to(torch.long)], dim=0)

    # Global cap while preserving at least one pair per instance when possible.
    total = b_idx.numel()
    if total > max_pairs:
        gap_sel = objective[b_idx, l_idx] - objective[b_idx, w_idx]

        best_score = torch.full((B,), float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        best_pos = torch.full((B,), -1, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
        best_score = best_score.scatter_reduce(0, b_idx, gap_sel, reduce='amax', include_self=True)

        is_best = gap_sel == best_score[b_idx]
        pos = torch.arange(total, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
        pos_best = torch.where(is_best, pos, torch.full_like(pos, total))
        best_pos = best_pos.scatter_reduce(0, b_idx, pos_best, reduce='amin', include_self=True)

        has_best = best_pos >= 0
        core_pos = best_pos[has_best]

        core_mask = torch.zeros((total,), device=objective.device, dtype=torch.bool)
        core_mask[core_pos] = True

        remaining = max_pairs - int(core_mask.sum().item())
        if remaining <= 0:
            sel_pos = core_pos
        else:
            rest_score = gap_sel.masked_fill(core_mask, float('-inf'))
            rest_k = min(remaining, total)
            _, rest_pos = torch.topk(rest_score, k=rest_k, largest=True, sorted=False)
            rest_keep = rest_score[rest_pos] > float('-inf')
            rest_pos = rest_pos[rest_keep]
            sel_pos = torch.cat([core_pos, rest_pos], dim=0)
            if sel_pos.numel() > max_pairs:
                sel_pos = sel_pos[:max_pairs]

        b_idx = b_idx[sel_pos]
        w_idx = w_idx[sel_pos]
        l_idx = l_idx[sel_pos]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1), w_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1), l_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1)),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_stratified_covercap',
            'n_winners': n_winners,
            'n_mid': n_mid,
            'n_tail': n_tail,
            'gap_threshold': gap_thr,
            'max_pairs': max_pairs,
            'max_pairs_per_instance': per_inst_cap,
        },
    )

    w_mid = int(extra.get('mid_window', 3))
    w_tail = int(extra.get('tail_window', 3))

    w_mid = max(1, min(w_mid, N))
    w_tail = max(1, min(w_tail, N))

    win_idx = sorted_idx[:, :w_win]  # [B, W]

    # Tail window: worst ranks [N-w_tail : N]
    tail_idx = sorted_idx[:, N - w_tail:]  # [B, T]

    # Mid window: a slice around the median ranks (deterministic, avoids round()).
    mid_center = N // 2
    mid_start = mid_center - (w_mid // 2)
    if mid_start < 0:
        mid_start = 0
    mid_start_max = N - w_mid
    if mid_start > mid_start_max:
        mid_start = mid_start_max
    mid_idx = sorted_idx[:, mid_start:mid_start + w_mid]  # [B, M]

    W = win_idx.shape[1]
    M = mid_idx.shape[1]
    T = tail_idx.shape[1]

    b0 = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)

    # Candidate pairs: win->mid, win->tail, mid->tail (rank-based pairing, not all-pairs).
    b_wm = b0[:, None, None].expand(B, W, M)
    w_wm = win_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, W, M)
    l_wm = mid_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, W, M)

    b_wt = b0[:, None, None].expand(B, W, T)
    w_wt = win_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, W, T)
    l_wt = tail_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, W, T)

    b_mt = b0[:, None, None].expand(B, M, T)
    w_mt = mid_idx[:, :, None].expand(B, M, T)
    l_mt = tail_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, M, T)

    b_all = torch.cat([b_wm.reshape(B, -1), b_wt.reshape(B, -1), b_mt.reshape(B, -1)], dim=1)  # [B, P]
    w_all = torch.cat([w_wm.reshape(B, -1), w_wt.reshape(B, -1), w_mt.reshape(B, -1)], dim=1)  # [B, P]
    l_all = torch.cat([l_wm.reshape(B, -1), l_wt.reshape(B, -1), l_mt.reshape(B, -1)], dim=1)  # [B, P]

    # Valid: exclude self, enforce strict preference (winner objective strictly lower than loser), and optional gap threshold.
    gap = objective.gather(1, l_all) - objective.gather(1, w_all)  # [B, P]
    valid = (w_all != l_all) & (gap > gap_thr)

    score = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)  # [B, P]

    if k < 1:

        l_fb = sorted_idx[:, N - 1]

                'max_pairs_per_instance': int(per_inst_cap),
                'win_window': int(w_win),
                'mid_window': int(w_mid),
                'tail_window': int(w_tail),
                'note': 'fallback_all_best_vs_worst'

        gap_sel = objective[b_idx, l_idx] - objective[b_idx, w_idx]

        best_score = torch.full((B,), float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
        best_pos = torch.full((B,), -1, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)

        is_best = gap_sel == best_score[b_idx.to(torch.long)]

    # Build rank-window pairs: for offsets s in [1..W], pair r with r+s.
    r = torch.arange(K, device=device, dtype=torch.long)[None, None, :]          # [1,1,K]
    s = torch.arange(1, W + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.long)[None, :, None]  # [1,W,1]
    loser_r = r + s                                                              # [1,W,K]
    valid_pos = loser_r < K                                                      # [1,W,K]

    w_idx_rank = sorted_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, W, K)  # [B,W,K]
    loser_r_clamped = torch.clamp(loser_r, 0, K - 1).expand(B, W, K)             # [B,W,K]
    # Gather along rank dimension (dim=2) by expanding sorted_idx to [B,W,K].
    l_idx_rank = sorted_idx[:, None, :].expand(B, W, K).gather(2, loser_r_clamped)  # [B,W,K]

    # Compute gap = obj[loser] - obj[winner] (positive means winner better).
    w_obj = objective.gather(1, w_idx_rank.reshape(B, W * K)).reshape(B, W, K)
    l_obj = objective.gather(1, l_idx_rank.reshape(B, W * K)).reshape(B, W, K)
    gap = l_obj - w_obj

    valid = valid_pos.expand(B, W, K) & (w_idx_rank != l_idx_rank) & (gap > gap_thr)
    neg_inf = torch.full((), float('-inf'), device=device, dtype=dtype)
    score = torch.where(valid, gap, neg_inf)  # [B,W,K]

    P = W * K
    score_flat = score.reshape(B, P)
    w_flat = w_idx_rank.reshape(B, P)
    l_flat = l_idx_rank.reshape(B, P)

    k = per_inst_cap
    if k > P:
        k = P
    if k < 1:
        k = 1

    topv, topi = torch.topk(score_flat, k=k, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)  # [B,k]
    keep = topv > neg_inf

    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None].expand(B, k)
    b_idx = b_grid[keep]
    w_idx = w_flat.gather(1, topi)[keep].to(torch.long)
    l_idx = l_flat.gather(1, topi)[keep].to(torch.long)

    # Coverage fallback (fully vectorized): ensure at least one pair per instance.
    per_b = torch.zeros((B,), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    if b_idx.numel() > 0:
        per_b.scatter_add_(0, b_idx, torch.ones_like(b_idx, dtype=torch.long))
    missing = per_b == 0

    best = sorted_idx[:, 0]
    worst = sorted_idx[:, -1]
    ar = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.long)
    gap_bw = objective[ar, worst] - objective[ar, best]
    ok_bw = missing & (best != worst) & (gap_bw > gap_thr)

    b_bw = torch.nonzero(ok_bw, as_tuple=True)[0]
    if b_bw.numel() > 0:
        b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_bw.to(torch.long)], dim=0)
        w_idx = torch.cat([w_idx, best[b_bw].to(torch.long)], dim=0)
        l_idx = torch.cat([l_idx, worst[b_bw].to(torch.long)], dim=0)

    still_missing = missing & (~ok_bw)
    b_tie = torch.nonzero(still_missing, as_tuple=True)[0]
    if b_tie.numel() > 0:
        z = torch.zeros((b_tie.numel(),), device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx, b_tie.to(torch.long)], dim=0)
        w_idx = torch.cat([w_idx, z], dim=0)
        l_idx = torch.cat([l_idx, z], dim=0)

    # Nonnegative weights from objective gap; enforce zero for self-pairs.
    gap_sel = objective[b_idx, l_idx] - objective[b_idx, w_idx]
    weight = gap_sel.clamp_min(0.0)
    neutral = (w_idx == l_idx)
    if bool(neutral.any().item()):
        weight = torch.where(neutral, weight.new_zeros(weight.shape), weight)

    # Global cap: keep largest-weight pairs deterministically.
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        sel = torch.topk(weight, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[sel]
        w_idx = w_idx[sel]
        l_idx = l_idx[sel]
        weight = weight[sel]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(
            b_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
            w_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
            l_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
        ),
        weight=weight.reshape(-1),
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_window_covercap_v3_strictvec',
            'rank_window': int(W),
            'gap_threshold': float(gap_thr),
            'max_pairs': int(max_pairs),
            'max_pairs_per_instance': int(per_inst_cap),
        },
    )
